utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I still need the final time and repair list before I can help spread the word—can you send those over?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can send the repair list—what final time should we put down?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I still need the repair list first, and I’d rather wait on the final time until we confirm it with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Dane — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries — sorting and moving donations is probably the biggest help right now. Tell me what you’d like me to handle.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not too late at all — I’m heading over later and still spreading the word, and we could use help with the screws, duct tape, and small tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s still on. Do you want me to help gather screws and duct tape, or should I focus on lining up a few more people?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Could you line up a few more people? I’ll keep gathering the word about the repair drive and the paint and patch supplies.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can keep spreading the word and point people toward the repair drive supplies. What needs the most help right now?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — I can help spread the word too, especially around school pickup and drop-off. Let me know if there’s a flyer or message I should share.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — I’ll put together a short flyer/message and send it over. School pickup sounds perfect, and I really appreciate you helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen any update yet, but I’m still checking near Maple Hall and the school pickup route. I’ll let you know as soon as I have the latest route and stop count.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Opal — keep me posted when you get the latest route and stop count. I’ve got the repair drive marked for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll keep checking, and I’ll let you know the moment I have the latest route and stop count.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—thanks for the reminder. What’s the latest on the repair drive, and is there anything I should bring or help with?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ve got you on the list, and helping track supplies sounds perfect. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything else about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks — just keep me posted. If you need anything else, I can help with the supplies list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what repairs are they focusing on this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly the quick fixes — leaky faucets, loose hinges, and small electrical issues. If you want, I can send the full list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please send the full list. That’ll help me plan what to bring and what to expect.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, good to know—sounds like it’s shaping up nicely. If I hear anything about the time or any last-minute needs, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess—please let me know as soon as you get the route and total stops. I want to make sure the drive time and staffing still make sense.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll pass along the route and stop count as soon as I hear it. I’ll keep an ear out for any staffing updates too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What’s the main thing you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly help spreading the word and getting the word out about what’s needed. If you can, I’d also appreciate any small tools or parts people can spare.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can help spread the word and see if anyone has small tools or parts to spare.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll send over the pickup details and a time that works. Thanks again, Rey.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, Mara — I’ll keep an eye out for your message and be ready to pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — I’ll message you the pickup details and a time shortly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good to hear — what kind of repairs are they focusing on for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure of all the details yet, but it sounds like they’re helping with basic home repairs and supplies. If I hear more, I’ll pass it along around the block.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Nell — if you hear about any specific needs, just let me know and I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — the repair drive is this Sunday at the community center now. Let me know if you can help spread the word or bring anything by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can spread the word and I’ll bring my drill and a few basic tools. Just let me know if there’s anything else you still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — that’ll help a lot. If you could also mention it’s Sunday at the community center, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping the details organized. If you can help spread the word, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I can spread the word and help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off. Sunday at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — that helps a lot. I’ll keep the update clear and organized, and I appreciate you spreading the word around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Maple Hall on 3rd Street, Saturday 10 to 2, right? Send me the main items and I’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Probably the main items are what I can grab fastest—just send me the list and I’ll take the biggest gap.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can look for the screws, duct tape, and small tools first. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, thanks, Rey—start with my shed by the back fence if you don’t mind. I’ll keep an eye out and bring over anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I’ll start at the shed by the back fence and check for those supplies. If I find anything, I’ll bring it over right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — that’d be a huge help. I’ll keep an eye out for the clamps and let you know if I spot anything else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, I’ll bring the drill and help sort the donations. Just let me know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Uli — thanks again. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it—I’m still waiting on the route and total stop count before I can say for sure. Once you have that, send it over and I’ll see if I can manage the pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds fair, Pia. I’ll send the route and stop count as soon as I have them so you can plan properly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli—once you send it, I’ll check the drive time and let you know if I can take the pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal — I can use help with spreading the word and sorting donations for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is at Maple Hall on 3rd Street, Saturday from 10 to 2. I’ll send you the route and stop count as soon as I have the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. Send the latest list when you have it, and I’ll start sorting donations.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll tell folks the repair drive is coming up and that anyone who can help with supplies is welcome.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell — that’s perfect. I’ll let you know if there are any updates, and if anyone asks, they’re welcome to bring supplies or lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — I’ll pass that along and keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira—just a reminder, the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center. If you have the updated supply list, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll pass along the updated list and keep an eye out for that cordless drill and those clamps while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — that’s perfect. If you spot any extra screws or tape too, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ve got the route mapped, and we’re keeping it to four stops total. Which spot do you want to start with?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Let’s start with the first stop on the route and see who needs the most help there. I can help get the word out while you keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good—let’s start at the first stop and see who needs the most help. I’ll keep things moving while you get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a big help, Hana—if you can, I’d love for you to help sort donations or do a quick pickup. Just tell me what works best for you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can help once I have the final repair list and time—could you send those over? Then I’ll know whether donations or a pickup works best.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll send the final repair list and time as soon as I have them. Thanks, Hana; once you see it, just let me know whether donations or a pickup works best.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s the loose fence by the mailbox and that broken step near the community room. I’m pretty sure the drive is this Saturday, but I’d double-check the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds right — I’d bring up both the loose fence and the broken step this Saturday. And yeah, the flyer should have the exact time if you want to double-check it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks — I’ll check the flyer for the time. I’m glad we’ve got the fence and step noted for Saturday.
